summary: Read and analyzed all build scripts, package.json configurations, CI/CD workflows, and release management for the Auto-Claude project. Documented root scripts/ (bump-version.js, validate-release.js, cleanup-version-branches.sh, install-backend.js, test-backend.js, update-readme.py), frontend scripts/ (Python bundling and packaging), root package.json (monorepo config, npm scripts), frontend package.json (Electron app with electron-builder config), CI workflow (multi-platform testing on Linux/Windows/macOS with 4+3 jobs), release workflows (prepare-release.yml validates CHANGELOG and creates tags, release.yml builds all platforms, beta-release.yml for beta releases), and the complete release flow from version bump to GitHub release.
current_status: Completed comprehensive documentation of build scripts, package configurations, CI/CD, and release management. Project is a monorepo with backend (Python) and frontend (Electron + React + Vite). Uses GitHub Actions for multi-platform CI/CD with automatic releases on version tag push.
